Triaged 2026-09-28 under the rule, on Anthony's request to review the issue, measured on 0.74.0 scratch stores.

FOUR ISSUES → 4 root-cause findings:
· an exposed server accepts an approval signed as anyone (the boundary was named in 2026-08 and no rule was chosen);
· a registry server silently drops a store with no identity, while single-design mode refuses it loudly;
· the Host refusal is the library's opaque 403, and the flag is named only once, at startup;
· a server degraded by a held lock never retries and passes a TCP health check.

IDEAS:
· Native OAuth contradicts the accepted ruling that reflow2 authenticates nothing (dec:the-registry-root-is-the-tenant-boundary), so it is recorded there as a request to reopen, awaiting Anthony's word, not as a new idea.
· Verifying a token for attribution is appended as option (e) to the open auth-layer decision, beside what the issue does to options (a) and (d).
· The reference deployment is appended to Alex's own team-server idea.

ALSO FOUND: points 1 (sign-in flow) and 2 (writes_for) of req:a-local-client-works-against-a-remote-reflow2-server-by-url are unbuilt and in no planned step.

The CAUSES and DOCUMENTS back-edges from this artifact name each record. No reply has been posted on GitHub.
